chargeModels.method: OpenFF NAGL AM1-BCC GNN v1.0, official chemical-domain validation enabled, readout am1bcc_charges
chargeModels.protocol: OpenFF Toolkit Molecule graph from indexed atoms/bonds; reject unsupported domain; explicit neutral total-charge constraint; no coordinate/conformer dependence
chargeModels.reproducibilityNote: Model SHA-256 is pinned in fileHashes; the lockfile pins the free/open-source developer environment. Do not use an unversioned latest model. Torch inference uses one intra-op and one inter-op thread.

chargeModels.method: explicit zero-charge neutral homonuclear diatomic approximation
chargeModels.source: Reaction Lab Stage A route manifest
chargeModels.protocol: Set both atoms to 0 e for H2, O2, N2, and Cl2; this is not a multipole or open-shell electronic-structure model
chargeModels.reproducibilityNote: Exact values and molecule IDs are listed in reaction-lab-nonbonded-routes.json.

chargeModels.protocol: Use matched LibraryCharges entries q-tip3p-O and q-tip3p-H; Sage library charges take precedence over NAGLCharges
chargeModels.reproducibilityNote: Water charge values are verified exactly as [-0.834, 0.417, 0.417] e.

chargeModels.method: AmberTools Antechamber AM1-BCC (SQM), deterministic RDKit ETKDGv3 conformer
chargeModels.protocol: Generate one conformer with the route manifest seed; minimize with RDKit MMFF94s when available; assign AM1-BCC using AmberToolsToolkitWrapper; enforce neutral total charge
chargeModels.reproducibilityNote: Used for explicit CO [C-]#[O+] and for AshGC domain/parameterization fallback. This is a deliberate fallback, not AshGC.

vdwModels.protocol: Match each atom against Sage vdW SMIRKS in the mapped OpenFF topology; record the OpenFF parameter id; normalize to sigma in angstrom and epsilon in kcal/mol
vdwModels.reproducibilityNote: When an input vdW parameter is expressed as rmin_half, sigma = (2*rmin_half)/2^(1/6). Use Sage TIP3P-specific atom parameters for water. No custom vdW overrides.
